answer: Make earning depend on income diversity, not on vetting keys. Per epoch, an identity is reward-eligible only if five distinct established payers paid it, and the lotus bound caps any single payer at 50% of its inflow. Payment flows are public, a lantern over the graph, and the concentration test is a basalt floor computed by consensus, no trusted issuer. Clones spawn freely yet cannot earn: paying themselves fails the established test, so each clone buys real service, a linear per-key cost; attack pays only while per-key reward outruns that fee, and a payer cartel can serve clones for a cut.
